name: Z-Image Turbo
description: Z-Image Turbo is Tongyi-MAI's 6B-parameter distilled text-to-image model, served by Pruna. It generates photorealistic images in about 8 steps, renders English and Chinese text well, and supports custom sizes up to 2048×2048.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

width.description: Width of the generated image in pixels (64-2048). Defaults to 1024.

height.description: Height of the generated image in pixels (64-2048). Defaults to 1024.

num_inference_steps.description: Number of inference steps (1-50). Defaults to 8.

guidance_scale.description: Guidance scale (0-20). Should be 0 for Turbo models, which is the default.

go_fast.description: Apply additional optimizations for faster generation. Defaults to false.

output_format.description: Format of the output image. Defaults to jpg.

output_quality.description: Quality when saving jpg or webp output, from 0 to 100. Defaults to 80.

enable_safety_filter.description: Check the prompt against the content policy. Defaults to false; the always-on categories are still blocked.

image.description: Presigned URL for the generated image.
